description:
The system is unstable in Hot Spot, a bold new sci-fi thriller set in a near-future society ruled by sentient artificial intelligence.

When a private eye is pulled into a murder investigation, the case leads him toward a rebel group with the power to threaten the digital overlord controlling the world. But as the truth comes closer, his own identity begins to collapse, sending the investigation into a hypnotic spiral of paranoia, control, and rebellion.

Directed by Agnieszka Smoczyńska and written by Robert Bolesto, Hot Spot stars Andrzej Konopka, Noomi Rapace, and Reika Kirishima. The film is set to arrive in theaters on August 21, 2026.
